This report reads the selected merged paper export by default. It includes all
completed fits, including diagnostic warnings. It does not rerun MCMC to render
saved results. The source manifest is in `../manifests/study1/`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE,message=FALSE,warning=TRUE)
here<-dirname(knitr::current_input(dir=TRUE))
source(file.path(here,"study1.R"),local=TRUE)
root<-if(nzchar(params$results_root)) params$results_root else Sys.getenv("EIVGP_RESULTS_ROOT")
if(!nzchar(root))stop("Set results_root or EIVGP_RESULTS_ROOT.")
result<-study1_analysis(root,params$action,params$profile,params$cores,
  tables_dir=if(nzchar(params$tables_dir))params$tables_dir else NULL,
  competitor_dir=if(nzchar(params$competitor_dir))params$competitor_dir else NULL)
```

## Method comparison

EIV-GP is fitted by our package. UC-GP, LVGP, and EzGP use their respective
packages through the package's comparison adapters. PI-GP and CC-GP are internal
ablations. MCSEs describe variation across replications, not within-fit MCMC error.

```{r scores, results='asis'}
if(params$action=="report") {
  cat("Selected source:",result$source,"\n\n")
  print(eivGP::report_table(result$summary,caption="Scores and replication MCSEs"))
} else print(result)
```

```{r comparison, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
if(params$action=="report") print(eivGP::plot_comparison(result$summary,"RMSE"))
```

## Diagnostics

Passing one diagnostic does not establish convergence for every estimand.
No fits are excluded from the score summaries on the basis of diagnostics.

```{r diagnostics, results='asis'}
if(params$action=="report") print(eivGP::report_table(eivGP::summarize_diagnostics(result$diagnostics)))
```

## Reproduction

Use `study1.R` for batch execution or change this notebook's action to `plan`,
`data`, `fit`, or `run`. New runs preserve the selected profile's scientific
settings and write to the external results folder. New package identities may
produce new run IDs; do not rename old caches to force compatibility.

```{r session, echo=FALSE}
packageVersion("eivGP")
sessionInfo()
```
